title: Pre-emptive evacuation for low-lying puroks
message: Families in flood-prone areas are advised to proceed to the nearest open evacuation center. Bring IDs, medicine, and water.

title: Covered Court is nearly full
message: New arrivals are encouraged to go to Pangabugan Elementary School or the Day Care Center.

title: Relief goods distribution at 12:00 NN
message: Family heads, please line up at the center registration desk with your family number.
